# world-layout v0.3
#
# This file is machine-written and machine-parsed. Humans DO NOT edit this file.
# Humans provide natural-language inputs (NL lines). These lines are immutable.
#
# Agents extract two things from the cumulative NL inputs:
#   (1) PHENOMENA       — behaviors or patterns that unfold over time
#   (2) DIMENSIONALITIES — variables/properties that can change over time
#
# Only PHEN and DIM represent the agent’s current best interpretation of the
# world described by ALL NL lines so far. These interpretations MAY be revised.
# PHEN/DIM snapshots appear after each NL line to show the full world state
# after processing that NL; the most recent snapshot is the current state.
#
# IMPORTANT:
#   - NL is append-only, preserved exactly as written.
#   - After every NL line, append the full PHEN/DIM snapshot reflecting the
#     world state after incorporating that NL (including any changes it
#     triggered). Duplication is expected; clarity is prioritized over size.
#   - PHEN and DIM MAY be replaced, updated, or superseded as understanding improves.
#   - Agent must ensure PHEN/DIM always reflect the most accurate world model.
#
# Example:
#   NL "a ball is dropped"
#   -> agent may infer PHEN falling; DIM height, velocity, gravity_strength
#
#   NL "on planet earth"
#   -> agent must revise previous DIM gravity_strength=9.8 m/s^2
#      if it had assumed another value or left it unspecified.
#
# PHENOMENON (PHEN):
#   Something that happens or unfolds over time.
#   Examples: "ball falls", "trucks queue", "inventory oscillates"
#
# DIMENSIONALITY (DIM):
#   A variable whose value may change over time.
#   Examples: position, velocity, queue_length, gravitational_strength
#
# SYNTAX:
#   NL <verbatim user text>
#   PHEN <id> description="<text>"
#   DIM  <id> description="<text>"
#
# RULES:
#   - NL is append-only and preserved verbatim.
#   - Each PHEN/DIM snapshot collectively represents the world interpretation
#     after processing that NL; the latest snapshot is the current state.
#   - PHEN/DIM MUST be updated when new NL changes meaning or invalidates assumptions.
#   - Agents may modify or replace PHEN/DIM lines, but must not modify NL lines.
#   - PHEN/DIM lines should follow the NL that triggered their creation or change.
#   - PHEN/DIM ids must be lowercase snake_case.
#   - Descriptions must be quoted strings.
#
# End of header.
NL "11x11 maze"
DIM grid_width description="maze width in cells, currently 11"
DIM grid_height description="maze height in cells, currently 11"
NL "there's a traverser in the maze"
PHEN traverser_navigation description="a traverser moves through the maze grid"
DIM grid_width description="maze width in cells, currently 11"
DIM grid_height description="maze height in cells, currently 11"
DIM traverser_presence description="whether a traverser occupies the maze, currently true"
DIM traverser_position description="traverser's coordinates within the grid, currently unspecified"
NL "there can be multiple traversers"
PHEN traverser_navigation description="traversers move through the maze grid, potentially simultaneously"
DIM grid_width description="maze width in cells, currently 11"
DIM grid_height description="maze height in cells, currently 11"
DIM traverser_presence description="whether at least one traverser occupies the maze, currently true"
DIM traverser_count description="number of traversers in the maze, currently at least 1"
DIM traverser_positions description="coordinates of each traverser within the grid, currently unspecified"
NL "each traverser has his own algorithm"
PHEN traverser_navigation description="traversers move through the maze grid using their own algorithms, potentially simultaneously"
DIM grid_width description="maze width in cells, currently 11"
DIM grid_height description="maze height in cells, currently 11"
DIM traverser_presence description="whether at least one traverser occupies the maze, currently true"
DIM traverser_count description="number of traversers in the maze, currently at least 1"
DIM traverser_positions description="coordinates of each traverser within the grid, currently unspecified"
DIM traverser_algorithms description="navigation algorithm assigned to each traverser, currently unique per traverser"
NL "traversers do not know the map ahead of time"
PHEN traverser_navigation description="traversers move through the maze grid using their own algorithms without prior map knowledge, discovering layout as they go, potentially simultaneously"
DIM grid_width description="maze width in cells, currently 11"
DIM grid_height description="maze height in cells, currently 11"
DIM traverser_presence description="whether at least one traverser occupies the maze, currently true"
DIM traverser_count description="number of traversers in the maze, currently at least 1"
DIM traverser_positions description="coordinates of each traverser within the grid, currently unspecified"
DIM traverser_algorithms description="navigation algorithm assigned to each traverser, currently unique per traverser"
DIM traverser_map_knowledge description="extent of each traverser's knowledge of the maze layout, currently none before traversal and gained through exploration"
NL "some traversers have a special ability, they can branch search, where they duplicate themselves and share a global memory of where they visited"
PHEN traverser_navigation description="traversers move through the maze grid using their own algorithms without prior map knowledge, potentially simultaneously, with some capable of branching into multiple copies that coordinate via shared visited-memory"
PHEN branching_search description="branch-capable traversers duplicate into multiple concurrent explorers that coordinate using shared memory of visited cells to cover the maze"
DIM grid_width description="maze width in cells, currently 11"
DIM grid_height description="maze height in cells, currently 11"
DIM traverser_presence description="whether at least one traverser occupies the maze, currently true"
DIM traverser_count description="number of traversers in the maze, currently at least 1; some may be branched copies of a single traverser"
DIM traverser_positions description="coordinates of each traverser and their branches within the grid, currently unspecified"
DIM traverser_algorithms description="navigation algorithm assigned to each traverser, currently unique per traverser; some include branching search"
DIM traverser_map_knowledge description="extent of each traverser's knowledge of the maze layout, currently none before traversal and gained through exploration; branch-capable traversers share visited-memory globally"
DIM traverser_branching_ability description="which traversers can duplicate into branches for parallel search, currently some traversers"
DIM branching_instances description="number of active branches per branch-capable traverser, currently variable and unspecified"
DIM branch_shared_memory description="shared record of visited locations used by branched traversers, currently global among branches"
